title: Taxonomic diversity of viruses in metagenomic sequences obtained from water sources and sewage in the metropolitan region of Sao Paulo
description: Metagenomic analysis of DNA viromes from environmental water and sewage samples collected in the metropolitan region of Sao Paulo, Brazil. The project includes pooled libraries from four sampling sites representing freshwater, treated water, and wastewater environments, generated by Illumina HiSeq 2500 paired-end sequencing for taxonomic and functional characterization of viral communities.
